sits.day: Saturday - 9/12/26  NC Museum of Art - park
sits.notes: Bring a cushion, sun and insect protection and hydration. We meet near the welcome center on the opposite side of the parking lot from the art museum. We sit in the center grass at the top of the hill.
sits.details: This is a thirty minute silent meditation. We usually have some fellowship - Dharma discussions before and after, nice but you are welcome to come and just meditate with us. Meditating in community and in the reality of the world is a great way to get used to conditions being not under our control. Also meditating outside connects us with the natural world.
